requirements.name: Direction ownership
requirements.assessment: Actual Git identity, registered origin, scope and narrow closure destinations are enforced. Native owner replay confirms the historical W01 exception. Disposable closure tests preserve foreign files and immutable origins; real W01 closure remains task4.4.

requirements.name: Uniform intake and research
requirements.assessment: Bootstrap records intake and explicit research/decision placeholders. Unresolved acceptance blocks dependent implementation while independent research remains available. Completed research and material decisions are owner/human responsibilities, not accepted scaffold output.

approvedBoundaries.meaning: Bootstrap records input and creates research/alternatives/risks/decision placeholders. Owner research and human product decisions must fill them before dependent acceptance; scaffold creation does not certify completed research.

requirements.name: Safe repeatable bootstrap
requirements.assessment: Actual temporary-Git plan/create/check controls verify isolation, collisions, links/traversal and identical partial recovery. Numeric seeded task IDs support initial and refreshed status. V03 does not recur.

requirements.name: Requirements and executable traceability
requirements.assessment: Every trace task requires nonempty reciprocal outgoing links; executable scenarios require assertions and source/config-bound trusted runs. Approved-budget and tampering controls remain intact. Installed planning declarations are rejected as executable proof; separate report mappings establish control coverage.

requirements.name: Sequential stage barriers
requirements.assessment: Sequential guards require current policy/PRE/RED/GREEN/check/Verify/POST evidence with the proper scope/source bindings. Focused diagnostic PASS cannot approve cumulative closure. Later closure tasks do not circularly block Verify.

requirements.name: STOP and root cause integrity
requirements.assessment: Two deterministic failed fixes require classified RCA and bound trusted proof. Historical failed runs coexist with newer passing evidence without deletion. RED, earlier failed review, formatting failure and canonical raw-diff origin are retained.

requirements.name: Applicable contract preservation
requirements.assessment: Predeclared applicability requires actual affected control checks and rejects false N/A. Native unchanged-product proof supports process-only product exclusions. Cached general commands do not establish uncached product success.

requirements.name: Owner-controlled adoption and integration
requirements.assessment: Completed legacy checkboxes conservatively mean pending closure. Supplier closure, consumer adoption and actual merged-candidate integration are distinct future owner boundaries under design9, not events executed here.

approvedBoundaries.meaning: Supplier closure and each existing owner’s adoption are deliberately independent. Supplier POST/release/archive remain tasks4.2–4.4; Routing/UI/Repo Core remain NOT_STARTED. No actual supplier closure or consumer adoption event is claimed.

An actual merged candidate, target SHA/conflict checks and integration POST/merge permission belong to separately authorized future integration. Feature POST cannot certify a later merge. No merge was performed or approved.

requirements.name: Exact model resolution
requirements.assessment: Exact role pairs depend on raw design/D03 bytes, revision and approval callback. All five installed roles pass current native assertions; missing/conflicting/ranged/drifting sources or unsupported overrides fail.

requirements.name: Automatic independent review
requirements.assessment: Exact packet scope, secrets/paths, pinned release/runtime and confinement canary remain enforced. Installed preflight is not full live POST. Fresh native discovery/probe supports runtime capability; cumulative POST remains task4.2.

requirements.name: Complete immutable review reception
requirements.assessment: Unchanged reception guards validate complete ordered events, final-report binding, candidate/raw-index freeze, raw retention and stopped reviewer. Unadmitted history cannot certify current code, and this reviewer cannot self-certify its future reception.

requirements.name: Separate requested and actual execution
requirements.assessment: Approved/requested/invoked provenance is separate from unattested backend/effort. Writer APIs explicitly remain unavailable. Tooling-worker repair execution is not product writer implementation.

requirements.name: Uniform status projection
requirements.assessment: Eight-section projection, legacy retention and owner provenance remain coherent. Read-only replay exactly reproduces the current a71 dashboard, its digest and one complete historical tail.

requirements.name: Truthful source-bound metrics
requirements.assessment: Completed tasks are now checked even without mappings. New native negatives and trusted positive control cover the reported defect. Explicit human/future boundaries remain pending; task counts and native passes never manufacture accepted metrics.

requirements.name: Event-driven status freshness
requirements.assessment: Freeze defers writes and is rechecked after awaited proof. Changed actual HEAD marks stale status; fresh a71 rendering and native historical-owner replay preserve current source and history semantics.

requirements.name: Durable checkpoint cadence
requirements.assessment: Scoped checkpoint admission binds candidate/event/check evidence, rejects missing GREEN and preserves honest blocker checkpoints. Historical and authenticated-current D04 assertions remain distinct; receipt-only recursive commits are rejected.

requirements.name: Authorized verified publication
requirements.assessment: Publication enforces external exact remote/ref/SHA authority, refuses divergence and destination rewrites, and confirms fresh remote SHA. Supplied a71 receipt matches; no reviewer network action occurred.

requirements.name: Minimal human decision boundary and onboarding
requirements.assessment: Guide syntax matches supported absolute-path CLI commands, decision responsibilities and unavailable writer. Positive bootstrap/status-library and installed admission/owner controls support its bounded examples. Material visual/spec/scope/destination decisions remain human.

approvedBoundaries.meaning: Tests enforce missing/forged decision blocking; material scope/spec/model/visual/destination decisions remain human. Findings in this report authorize neither production repair nor plan/spec/scope change.
